name: Inescapable Grasp (Combat, Mythic)
body:
It is almost impossible for foes to wriggle free from your grasp.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Grapple or grab special attack.

Benefit(s): Your CMD against attempts to escape from your grapple is increased by an amount equal to your mythic tier, whether such attempts are made as a grapple combat maneuver or an Escape Artist skill check. In addition, you can grapple creatures using freedom of movement, though you take a base -20 penalty on combat maneuver checks made to grapple such a target. This penalty is reduced by an amount equal to your mythic tier (if your target is a mythic creature or is using mythic freedom of movement) or by twice your mythic tier otherwise.
